card.name: Section numbers in highlight cross-references
card.fires_on: The section number or opening bracket right after an open parenthesis, as in a cross-reference like (5.1) in drug-label highlights. It also fires on a few other delimiters, such as a closing parenthesis after a time zone.

modes.label: Section number in parentheses
modes.description: The first digit of a section cross-reference such as (5.1) or (2.1) that closes a warning sentence.

modes.label: Other delimiters in metadata
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or table bar in dated or form-style web text.

card.plain: It marks the number inside a section reference like (5.1) at the end of a label warning.
